# BrowseChrome v0.2.3 - Table of Contents

Manage headless Chrome instances via the Chrome DevTools Protocol

## Pages

- [🌐 BrowseChrome](https://browse-chrome.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [BrowseChrome](https://browse-chrome.hexdocs.pm/BrowseChrome.md): Manage headless Chrome instances via the Chrome DevTools Protocol.
- [BrowseChrome.BrowserPool](https://browse-chrome.hexdocs.pm/BrowseChrome.BrowserPool.md): Compatibility wrapper around `Browse` for pools of warm `BrowseChrome.Chrome` workers.

- [BrowseChrome.CDP](https://browse-chrome.hexdocs.pm/BrowseChrome.CDP.md): A minimal Chrome DevTools Protocol client over WebSocket.
- [BrowseChrome.Chrome](https://browse-chrome.hexdocs.pm/BrowseChrome.Chrome.md): A GenServer that manages a headless Chrome/Chromium instance.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix version](https://browse-chrome.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Version.md): Manage the project version in mix.exs.
